description.value: A-Frame Brewing is a craft brewery and taproom in Squamish, BC, open since December 2016 and built around the nostalgia of BC lake cabin life — each beer is named after a beloved provincial lake. The spacious patio features a fire pit and resident food truck Flipside Burgers, and the BYO-food policy makes it a relaxed, accessible stop for hungry visitors. The brewery has earned multiple Canadian Brewing Awards, including Gold for its Arctic Lake Dark Lager at the 2023 nationals.
